pages.text: $(l)Create$() builds machines from moving parts: shafts, cogs, belts and windmills carry $(l)rotational force$() around, and contraptions physically move in the world instead of processing items in a box.$(br2)Its processing happens on millstones, mixers and presses, which are not crafting recipes.

$(l)Tier 2$(): zinc and its ores at 18 FU, andesite alloy at 12.$(br2)$(l)Tier 3$(): brass 22, rose quartz 10.$(br2)Andesite alloy is the mod's early staple and is priced accordingly, so printing a stack of it is never the cheap route past actually building the machine that makes it.
